notes: Speaker left floating as in Japanese.

items.english: They jumped back into the water, crying "Oh, deep, deep!" and stamping their feet and thrashing their arms like figures in a picture of men bewitched by a fox.
notes: Joined in English as p186 ends on the quotative to leading into p187.

items.english: "Thrash them in every which way!" Taki ordered.
A and B themselves looked like leaping fish. Spray like a fountain came pattering like rain on the leaves of the pondweed at the water's edge.
notes: Kawahone, a pond lily, rendered plainly as pondweed.

items.english: "A water fight on a hot day!" A muttered, abashed.
"Yikes! Something brushed past my calf going by, ugh, creepy!" B said, rubbing his chest.
"All out attack!" A shouted, and with a whoop the two closed in on the mouth of the trap.
notes: Oikomi no kuchi kept as mouth of the trap for the drive net enclosure.

items.english: "Ah, what fun, what fun." Taki clapped his hands, his mouth wide open.
When evening came the two came up beside Taki and, scratching their heads, said, "At this rate, well..."
notes: Joined in English as one movement: approach, trailing remark and gesture. Speakers left floating as in Japanese.

items.english: "Oh, take your time over it. From tomorrow let's lay off the rough stuff and think it over somehow. It would be silly to damage such fine things."
"You need not stand on ceremony about that. Once we catch them to our satisfaction there is nothing to worry about. I have made up my mind to sell the lot, not one left."
notes: Kept plain catch for tsukamaeru throughout.

items.english: "Won't we lose face with the people at the other house?"
notes: Speaker and which house is meant left as in Japanese, not settled from the passage.

data.say: Pond siege drafted with workmen rough and catch kept plain.
